data.summary: Detail-oriented finance professional with 6+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Trade Settlement, Reconciliation, and Client Management. Proven expertise in Equity and OTC listed derivative settlement across DTCC and Euroclear. Hands-on experience in SSI validation and maintenance, pre-matching, settlement fails, month-end closing, end-of-day balancing, reconciliation, and CSDR-related controls. Strong track record of resolving settlement exceptions, coordinating with brokers and custodians, and delivering accurate client reporting.

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Detail-oriented finance professional with 6+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Trade Settlement, Reconciliation, and Client Management. Proven expertise in Equity and OTC listed derivative settlement across DTCC and Euroclear. Hands-on experience in SSI validation and maintenance, pre-matching, settlement fails, month-end closing, end-of-day balancing, reconciliation, and CSDR-related controls. Strong track record of resolving settlement exceptions, coordinating with brokers and custodians, and delivering accurate client reporting.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Trade Settlement (Equity & Derivatives) (cid:127) OTC & Listed Derivatives (cid:127) Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI) (cid:127) SSI Validation & Maintenance (cid:127) CSDR Compliance (cid:127) Reconciliation (cid:127) Trade Confirmation & Pre-Matching (cid:127) End-of-Day Balancing (cid:127) Month-End Closing (cid:127) Middle & Back Office Operations (cid:127) Client Reporting (cid:127) SWIFT Messages (cid:127) Broker & Custodian Coordination (cid:127) Escalation Management
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Associate – Trade Settlement | BNY (Bank of New York) Oct 2024 – Jan 2026
(cid:127) Managed daily settlement of high-value Equity and OTC listed derivative products.
(cid:127) Performed hands-on pre-matching and settlement activities, checking and ensuring SSI accuracy in counterparty SWIFT
messages for trades across DTC and Euroclear markets and amending instructions when required.
(cid:127) Maintained and updated Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI) in ALERT, supporting accurate settlement and reducing
instruction-related fails.
(cid:127) Performed trade confirmation and pre-matching to reduce fails, overdraft charges, and CSDR penalties.
(cid:127) Performed end-of-day balancing activities, validating settlement and cash/position records and investigating discrepancies before
daily close.
(cid:127) Supported month-end closing activities, completing required reconciliations, validations, and outstanding-item checks to ensure
accurate and timely operational close.
(cid:127) Liaised with trading desks, sales, IT teams, brokers, and custodians to ensure seamless end-to-end settlement processing.
(cid:127) Resolved failing trades by coordinating with brokers and custodians on shorts, stock loans, and instruction mismatches.
(cid:127) Monitored the group mailbox to ensure queries were actioned on time according to priority and SLA requirements.
Real Estate Analyst (FTC) | MSCI Jan 2024 – Jul 2024
(cid:127) Collected and validated real estate data from institutional clients including income, expense components, and property details for
completeness and accuracy.
(cid:127) Analysed income and expense components to ensure data integrity.
(cid:127) Performed reconciliation of real estate data by comparing current vs. historical records; identified discrepancies and coordinated
client clarifications.
(cid:127) Generated monthly, quarterly, biannual, and annual benchmark reports for clients based on subscription packages.
Executive | Equentis Wealth Advisory Pvt Ltd Jun 2023 – Dec 2023
(cid:127) Empowered clients to make informed financial decisions through clear communication on investment products tailored to individual
financial goals.
(cid:127) Managed end-to-end KYC onboarding process and provided technical support for client integration into company systems.
Virtual Relationship Manager | ICICI Prudential Asset Management Jul 2021 – Oct 2022
(cid:127) Managed a dedicated client base of 1,500+ investors, building long-term relationships to drive satisfaction, loyalty, and AUM
retention.
(cid:127) Provided information on market scenarios and catered to short- and long-term investment needs.
(cid:127) Delivered goal-based mutual fund guidance and resolved investment and operational queries.
Relationship Manager | HDFC Bank Dec 2019 – Jun 2021
(cid:127) Facilitated onboarding of CASA accounts and provided end-to-end support for loan and credit card applications.
(cid:127) Drove portfolio growth by identifying client needs and cross-selling tailored insurance and financial solutions.
raw_sections.education:
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) — Shankar Narayan Arts, Science & Commerce College, Mumbai | 2017

Certification in Investment Banking Operations — Imarticus Learning | 2022
